answer: Run a surprise roll call: at a random minute each epoch, every account gets its own fresh question and must reply within ninety seconds. Because all checks fire at once, an operator with fifty fakes needs fifty live reasoning streams at that instant instead of one reused worker, so peak compute grows with every clone. Picture a meadow where each terrace lamp must light in the same moment. Accounts that miss the call or send near-identical replies forfeit that epoch's reward, like an opal left in a drawer that never catches the light.
